The '''Svet-Orinan War''' was a Khalari conflict listed in the old source as lasting from 1973 to 1975.

== Source Basis ==

The extracted [[List of Wars]] gives only the conflict title and date range. The name implies a war between the [[Svetkhanul Republic]] and the [[Orinian Empire]], both of which are shown on the 2003 and 2022 maps in Khalari.

== Canon Limits ==

This draft does not invent the war's cause, outcome, casualties, or border changes. It preserves the war as a pre-1994 timeline anchor until a dedicated source or user ruling fills the details.
